coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Twelve attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: v2 at 8c051860 and frozen v1 at afdf676e both 0444 and unmoved, HEAD never left 0fcf3d3, file 08 at 3a9442d1, governing tree clean. I re-measured the live baseline before trusting anything: 30 gate rows through DR-G30, 27 OPEN, condition-4 reading 30 of 30 owners and 26 of 26 required, exactly D-158's After operand, so that write landed byte-faithfully. All three of my v1 SHOULD-FIX landed, each verified against live bytes rather than against the artifact's own disposition block. condition4Effect states the true effect — zero — and I tested its sharpest clause rather than accepting it: G09, G14 and G16 do sit inside the required 26 and already name identifiers, since the four gates outside that set are G06, G11, G13 and G17. COORD is pinned and the remeasurement clause matches the adopted v6 template. v5 and monorepo-ci-contract.v16 are both pinned and both reproduce, so the authorities the naming rests on are now measurable from this file. The repair is additive: four keys added, none removed, and all nine verbatim quotations plus all three placements byte-identical to v1. That last check is the one that mattered most, because file 08 has moved twice since v1 was frozen and a quotation can go stale with no one editing it; all nine still compare exactly against the current register, including the G16 owner's C4 parenthetical. Two substantive edits are improvements, not drift: G09's executes now disclaims confinement explicitly, and its doesNotClaim replaces a stale leftover reference with the accurate statement that those ten classes are named at G29 and G30, which I confirmed against both live rows. On the EE-6b question — the row where I once accepted a false enforcement claim — I went to primary bytes: permission-truth-tables.v9 is live at 05d55964, exactly the digest v5 cites, and it holds that presenting a brokered denial as though the effect were prevented is a defect FX-2B exists to catch. v2 claims disclosure honesty, leaves demonstrated prevention at DR-128, and disclaims confinement twice. One disclosure: Codex accepted v1 where I rejected it; the repairs landed regardless, and I record the split rather than smoothing it.
